_comment: Briscola locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (A, 2..7, J, Q, K), the suit symbols (carried in the {card}/{trump_card} slots), or numeric counts/points/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol (♠♥♦♣) - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. '7♠' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A card label, e.g. 'A♥' - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: The number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{points}: A number of points (card value or accumulated score)
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered score line, or the final per-player score block
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{tricks}: A number of tricks won by a player
_slots.{deck_count}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start: ເກມ Briscola ເລີ່ມຕົ້ນ! ຊຸດ Trump: {trump_suit} (ບັດ Trump: {trump_card})

prompt.intro: ທ່ານກໍາລັງຫຼີ້ນ Briscola - Player {player_id} ເປົ້າຫມາຍ: ຊະນະ tricks ແລະເກັບກໍາຈຸດຫຼາຍທີ່ສຸດ (120 ຈຸດທັງຫມົດໃນ deck). Card Points: A=11, 3=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, ອື່ນໆ=0 Card Power: A > 3 > K > Q > J > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2 ບັດ Trump ເອົາຊະນະບັດທີ່ບໍ່ແມ່ນບັດ trump ບໍ່ວ່າຈະເປັນພະລັງງານ. ການປະຕິບັດ: '[play X] 'ບ່ອນທີ່ X ແມ່ນຕໍາແຫນ່ງ (1-{max_pos}) ຂອງບັດໃນມືຂອງທ່ານ

hand.empty: ບໍ່ມີບັດໃນມື

trick.empty: ບໍ່ມີບັດຫຼິ້ນຍັງ trick ນີ້.
trick.header: ການຫລອກລວງໃນປະຈຸບັນ:

turn.score_entry: ນັກຫຼິ້ນ {player_id}: {points} pts
turn.trump_info: ຊຸດຂອງທຣໍາ: {trump_suit}
turn.trump_info_deck: ຊຸດ Trump: {trump_suit} │ ບັດທີ່ຍັງເຫຼືອຢູ່ໃນໂຖ: {deck_count}
turn.board: {hand} {trick} ຄະແນນ: {scores} {trump_info} ຫຼິ້ນບັດໂດຍໃຊ້ [play X]

invalid_move.wrong_format: ໃຊ້ [play X] ບ່ອນທີ່ X ແມ່ນ ຕໍາ ແຫນ່ງ ບັດ (1, 2, 3, ແລະອື່ນໆ)
invalid_move.out_of_range: ຕໍາແຫນ່ງບັດທີ່ບໍ່ຖືກຕ້ອງ. ທ່ານມີບັດ {count} (1-{count})

action.played: ນັກເຕະ {player_id} ຫຼິ້ນ {card}
action.trick_win: ຜູ້ນ {winner} ຊະນະການຫລອກລວງດ້ວຍ {card} ແລະໄດ້ຮັບ {points} ຈຸດ!

outcome.head: ເກມສິ້ນສຸດ! ຜູ້ນ {winner} ຊະນະດ້ວຍ {points} ຄະແນນ! ຄະແນນສຸດທ້າຍ: {scores}
outcome.player_line: ຜູ້ຫຼິ້ນ {player_id}: {points} ຄະແນນ ({tricks} ຕັວກະມົນ)
